description:
My strengths are research, planning, idea design, system architecture, problem-solving and meticulous attention to detail. I can shape the concept, design the gameplay and mission logic, plan execution and collaborate closely with developers to bring our ideas to life.

Who I’m looking for: Game developers, game designers and UI/UX designers are especially welcome. Anyone with a solid plan, creative ideas or relevant skills wish to make the team great is encouraged to join.
